summary: Iran launched ballistic missiles targeting US air bases in Jordan, including King Hussein and Al-Azraq, with footage showing Patriot systems engaging incoming threats. The IRGC claimed responsibility for strikes on infrastructure at both bases. Israel reported killing Hamas operatives in Gaza and conducting airstrikes in southern Lebanon.
key_points: Iranian ballistic missiles struck US air bases in Jordan, including King Hussein and Al-Azraq, with IRGC claiming responsibility for targeting infrastructure and aircraft positions. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88856)
American Patriot air defense systems engaged numerous incoming Iranian ballistic missiles over Jordan, according to footage and reports. (Source: @shin_persian/9235)

Israeli airstrikes in Jabalia, northern Gaza, killed Hamas operatives including Abd al-Fatah Abu al-Eish, a commander in Hamas's military wing who participated in the October 7 attacks. (Source: @idf_telegram/25013)
Israeli forces destroyed a residential building in the village of Zawtar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, according to Lebanese media reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/134435)
Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps launched a combined drone and missile operation codenamed 'Muhammad ibn Abd Allah' targeting US military infrastructure in Jordan. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387728)

Israeli Defense Forces eliminated two Hamas operatives in Khan Younis, Yasser Abu al-Hayr and Muhammad al-Ateya, accused of planning attacks against Israeli troops and civilians. (Source: @almogboker78/18083)
Iranian missiles were observed launching from Zanjan Province, with air defense activity detected over Jordan following the attacks. (Source: @shin_persian/9232)
Qatar's Interior Ministry raised security threat levels and urged residents to remain indoors after Iranian strikes, while Kuwait shut oil well flames to prevent targeting. (Source: @presstv/204799)

sections.threat_assessment: Regional tensions have escalated significantly following Iran's coordinated ballistic missile and drone assault on US air bases in Jordan. The IRGC's claim of responsibility for strikes on King Hussein and Al-Azraq bases indicates deliberate targeting of US military infrastructure. Israeli operations in Gaza and southern Lebanon demonstrate continued cross-border activity. Gulf states including Qatar and Kuwait have heightened security measures, reflecting broader regional instability. The involvement of American Patriot systems in intercepting Iranian missiles suggests potential for further escalation.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states have responded to Iranian missile activity with heightened security measures, including Qatar raising threat levels and Kuwait shutting oil well flames. Egypt and UAE central banks affirmed continued financial coordination despite US sanctions. Saudi Arabia reported temporary airport shutdowns. The US has deployed Patriot systems in Jordan, indicating active defense posture. Regional actors are preparing for potential retaliation following Iranian strikes on US bases.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian missile launches originated from Zanjan Province, with air defense activity detected over Jordan. Footage shows Patriot systems engaging incoming threats, confirming active combat operations. The IRGC's use of combined drone and missile tactics in Operation 'Muhammad ibn Abd Allah' demonstrates evolving operational capabilities. Israeli airstrikes continue targeting Hamas infrastructure in Gaza and southern Lebanon. Regional alert systems in Lebanon documented extensive overnight activity including drone detections and airstrikes.
